REPAIR.name: Search | NonBrand | Heating Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-09
REPAIR.ceiling_basis: historical Furnace Repair keyword cluster average CPC $54.08 across 114 clicks and 17 conversions ($362.64 CPA); converting furnace queries priced $39.93 and $54.12; Planner shows LOW competition and returned no bid estimate at this volume. $38.00 trims the top of the historical distribution while staying above the conservative CPQL-derived figure, so delivery is not strangled.
REPAIR.cpql_math: provisional repair CPQL target $250; measured click->conversion 14.9% is an UPPER BOUND because duplicate Primary actions inflate it. held_services.Oil Heating campaign (Campaign 3): Planner: oil furnace installation 10/mo, oil heating system replacement 0/mo. Account history: 36 clicks, 3 conversions over several years at $43.17 CPC. Demand does not justify a campaign or budget. DOCUMENTED HOLD.
held_services.SKAG | Heat Pump Installation (WHOLE AD: BLOCKED BY GOOGLE POLICY. validate_only on the exact canonical final URL https://ambientcoolingandheating.com/services/heating-services/heat-pumps/ returns policy topic DESTINATION_NOT_WORKING (PROHIBITED) on 4 of 4 attempts. The page itself returns HTTP 200 and 338,002 bytes to AdsBot-Google and AdsBot-Google-Mobile on every fetch, and non-canonical variants of the same URL validate OK - so this is a persistent policy verdict cached against that exact URL string, not a live page fault. The URL was NOT swapped for a passing variant, because that would be evading policy review rather than resolving it. Next action: appeal / request re-review of that URL in the Google Ads UI, then add this ad group under a new fingerprint.
